[previewyoutube=iqRIAC82eJE;full][TRAILER][/previewyoutube]

Happy Togges release day to all of you!

notes.title: Togges Dev Diary #3: Say Hello to King President and The Togges!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40084717/81dc88b58b83f8d4509ca6c39ce8261285114d7a.jpg[/img]

Hey there, Togges Trainees!

In today's dev diary, you will meet some beloved characters out of the [b]Togges[/b] universe: For example the one and only King President, and of course the Togges themselves. And learn why the colorful Togges look like they actually do. Hey ho, let's go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40084717/2d7730f9b154cb5e6fa4a9a0cc9290481eb94eed.jpg[/img]

King President was born to be the game itself, talking to the player. Because we were inspired by Katamari Damacy ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1550270/announcements/detail/3504392437863304061]see past blog post[/url]), the idea of an all-mighty king trying to dominate the universe seemed so silly in a game about placing cute blocks in the worlds, and that instantly appealed to us!

I, Lucas, was very hesitant about the style of humour present in the game’s writing at the beginning of our journey because I had not done much writing in the past.. But in the playtest sessions, people were laughing at the game's absurd humour, which mostly comes from King President himself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40084717/eb7263ac0e73316930a4c1477cfdcc7e96c8f8ab.jpg[/img]

It was really satisfying and touching to see people enjoying the silly story in our game, and it felt like a great moment and milestone in my life. So, I kept developing the King’s personality as we drew inspiration from the King in Katamari Damacy and Garfield. And so, in the end, that self-centred, egocentric, over-the-top King President stole the show.

Okay, so much for King President. And what about the Togges? It was a simple process. The design of the Togges was settled before even the game existed! They were made to look like “cube plushies with faces” and to fit the block gameplay. As it turns out, people seem to really like them, so we have stuck with the original concept, just tweaking some of the visuals here and there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40084717/588303860840d3740b1f171e4901013b29a3b6ba.png[/img]

We took inspiration from the servbots’ personalities in Megaman Legends and designed the Togges to appear like innocent, pure, almost angelic creatures. We wanted to make people care for their Togges, which is one of the reasons we made them so cute. This is also reflected in the theme of the first level, their home, considering the visuals and the music.

So, what are the Togges? Well, they are some alien race with their own society and rules that we humans do not comprehend. While they see King President as a father figure, they are not actually his children. And they are not just copies of one another! Each Togge has its own life and personality, even if they talk and react almost in the same way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40084717/40b793a83390cb673509da8a3ca58ae03a32e93b.jpg[/img]

The release is closing in, but we still have another dev diary to share with you next week. And even more! Make sure to spend the [b]Togges[/b] Steam page a visit now and then. Oh, and if you are interested in our little game, please follow and wishlist it. That would really help us a lot! ❤️

Thanks so much for your time, friends! 
Lucas and Felipe - The Togges Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550270/Togges/

notes.title: Togges Dev Diary #2: That's How The Idea Of Togges Was Born!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40084717/3a45f26ff95615508fd4b908d3af296526742a6b.jpg[/img]

Greetings Togges Trainees,  

We are back with a new exciting topic to discuss in today's dev diary! We will take a trip back in time and read about our inspiration behind [b]Togges[/b] and how the idea was born from something completely different to what you will see when experience the full game at the release on [b]December 7th![/b]

Like the game itself, that's a crazy story. Initially, [b]Togges[/b] was kind of Bomberman-ish, where instead of removing blocks, you (the player) add the blocks. But we were focusing on the single-player aspect because that's what I most love about this franchise.

[img]https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/9he4LjdZUxSNNtSxvNLPZazlmEQEZUpzfvN95nbQs3u-SAkqtYxbpBZh2-FDY6SLiSZ4Qxndw0JokT3MqlAjoYiZlcgkbTzmJXUK9oRRVqhlAO-eq6wCmexi9wbN7MymSlELzUYi6gD2hi1WNA9buKjOG408YbEoRjdoELhgeEUBAEMVdXOSME2xkTnGqw[/img]

Since we were doing a single-player game, and because of our past experiences with 3D art and design, we were trying to create immersive, atmospheric worlds, with cartoonish stylish visuals, like something along the line of Donkey Kong Tropical Freeze. But one thing that we realized really early on while prototyping is that it's not exactly adding blocks that makes it fun to play, it's where you place the blocks.

The idea naturally grew with this simple approach, and the initial inspiration was left behind (Sorry Bomberman fans!). But instead, we noticed that it was a very simple and addictive gameplay loop, at the same time very unique and weird, so the Katamari inspiration was inevitable. In the early stages of development, we even had a similar game mechanic like in Katamari: Increasing the size as you play the game. In the end, we adapted this idea to the green Togge:

[previewyoutube=7gUzEqUEW9w;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7gUzEqUEW9w[/previewyoutube]
Some people compare it to the Pikmin series as well. While it was not intentional, I can see why. In [b]Togges[/b], there are multiple Togges colors, and each one has a different ability that expands the game's main mechanic, like in Pikmin. The colors were added to the game to create emergent gameplay, where the player can overcome the challenge of how they feel right. This idea came from playtesting, where people were trying to break the game, so we completely embraced it instead of removing the possibility!

Of course, it was not a straight line. Since we started Regular Studio, our goal has been to make something unique. While we achieved our goal, it wasn't without a lot of trouble trying to figure out how to make this idea work.

The game is seen as a puzzle platformer, but it was not created with this in mind. The design approach with [b]Togges[/b] was exploring the idea of adding blocks, no matter what it is. So, we created a concept and asked ourselves: "How would those little blocks react to this situation?" - For example, how do those little blocks behave in a big city? What kind of activities would you expect to see with this concept? And so we created the levels, themes, stories, mechanics and level design with this approach.

It was a really fun ride; I can assure you this! We pushed our creativity to the limit, and we are really proud of the crazy things we managed to create with a single game mechanic that doesn't change throughout the whole game.

Writing about the inspiration behind [b]Togges[/b] brings back so many memories and makes us really emotional about our progress over the years. And we even have so much more to share with you! In the next Dev Diary, we will look closer at the infamous King President and Togges!

Thanks so much for your time, friends! ːsteamhappyː
Lucas and Felipe - The Togges Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550270/Togges/

notes.title: Togges Dev Diary #1: Meet The Brothers Behind Togges!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40084717/b9d2beeb5337a679d731e1bc80bf71d660c27ac2.jpg[/img]

Greetings Togges Trainees,

And welcome to the first-ever [b]Togges[/b] Dev Diary! Let's start this little series by introducing the duo behind the game - Hi, that's us! You will get to know us as good as we do afterwards - including our favourite food, the last songs we listened to, etc. And a whole lot about [b]Togges[/b], of course! 

In the coming weeks, in the run-up to the official release, we will be sharing more interesting information with you here on Steam, and take a closer look into the creation of [b]Togges[/b].

So, are you ready to meet us? ːsteamhappyː 

[img]https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/WhA2wtTxlsmgAk6klonBt1hTDNhjMIgvnqV9ZmyT3326xGpKsN4AuM6HhmfQsEa-QvOk2_Hm6N6R1XkBqSaSlHBRihRLk8ET6riZBDPRPnww_qCgOUbCOdgrqR5l044piTQOkrWn4rJ3r-pA77Jd5x9VB_y6Q7jgtadID2CkJpfEZ4aiBWAlxpu6hbkDjw[/img]

We are two brothers living in the countryside of Brazil, and [b]Togges[/b] is our big dream game that’s coming true on [b]December 7th[/b]. As indie devs, we are an army of two, so we kind of do everything that needs to be done, with no pre-established roles. It's like this: 

[i]“Hey man, we need some sound effects for this thing, can you do it?”[/i]
Or: [i]“Can you fix that part of the scenery, like, right now?!”[/i]

It's crazy, but you never get bored, that's for sure.

[b][u]Name:[/u][/b] [i]Lucas[/i]
[b][u]Role:[/u][/b] [i]Everything, literally.[/i]
[b][u]What are you playing right now?[/u][/b] [i]God of War Ragnarok & Sonic Frontiers[/i]
[b][u]What is your favourite food?[/u][/b] [i]A good old burger[/i]
[b][u]What's the latest song you’ve listened to?[/u][/b] [i]Pikmin 2 Mystic Marsh EXTENDED - Nothing like listening to a chill OST while working[/i] 
[b][u]Which Togge would you become if you had to choose?[/u][/b] [i]Well, King President is a Togge as well, so I would choose him, mainly because I am the one who created him. ːsteamhappyː[/i]

[b][u]Name:[/u][/b] [i]Felipe[/i]
[b][u]Role:[/u][/b] [i]Everything, except coding.[/i]
[b][u]What are you playing right now?[/u][/b] [i]Ico, is a classic masterpiece.[/i]
[b][u]What is your favourite food?[/u][/b] [i]Cookies![/i]
[b][u]What's the latest song you’ve listened to?[/u][/b] [i]Does it need to be a song? Does 10 hours of relaxing forest sounds count? LMAO[/i]
[b][u]Which Togge would you become if you had to choose?[/u][/b] [i]The white one for sure. It's the most overpowered one.[/i]

Now you know more about the two of us! In the next Dev Diary, we will take a closer look at what inspired us when creating the game. And to make sure you don't get bored until then, you should definitely take a look at our [b]Togges[/b] demo here on Steam.

Because you don't become King President of the Universe just like that!

Happy exploring everyone!
Lucas and Felipe - The Togges Team

And for all of you who are not able to pay BitSummit X-Roads a visit: There is no need to be sad! The [b]Togges[/b] demo is also playable here on Steam. I hope you will enjoy playing it! 

If you're having a good time do us a favor and follow [b]Togges[/b] here on Steam, add the game to your wishlist and leave your feedback in the Steam Community Hub. That would help us a lot. ❤️

Oh, and don't miss out on the other demos of Thunderful's games that are playable at BitSummit X-Roads: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1004370/Paper_Cut_Mansion/]Paper Cut Mansion[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1726120/Cursed_to_Golf/]Cursed to Golf[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1276660/Tinkertown/]Tinkertown[/url]!

Over and out!
Lucas & the Togges Team
